items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: His brother plays good too down the road.

ctx.x: Larry Shields. Wonderful. His brother plays good too down the road. This person was just here. They think that there's nobody like the Shields playing on it now with Chalky. Yeah, Harry is. She said she never liked Clarence, but she liked him.
Yeah, very good. Any other trombone players? How did Happy Schilling play? He's retired now. I talked to him.

items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: I think we played a parade one day. Georgie Brunas was playing some wrong

ctx.x: We saw Jack Lane on Friday. They took a television movie for the educational television station. He's going to have a little interview and movie with him some of these days on there. Yeah. He's in good health, looked pretty good. He does. His wife is all right too, but she has trouble with her legs now. Oh, she does. He can't walk very well. Did you ever get to play with Papa Lane yourself?

I think I played only one job with him. Well, I was really playing with his son. With his son. His son played cornet, but he happened to play bass drum. I think we played a parade one day. Georgie Brunas was playing some wrong, and I think Emmet Rogers played the snare drum that day, and Jack played bass drum. Of course, we were kids then.
Yeah. He said he had a lot of boys working for him. All the Brunas brothers were pretty young when they worked for him and started with him.
